name: Busa Client Reporting
description: Agency client-reporting desk: per-client projects, deliverables, KPI snapshots, milestones and a read-only report page for each client

agentPrompts.label: Open a client's report page
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-client-reporting` skill in this folder, then open the report page for the client I name and walk me through its headline KPIs, deliverables and next steps. Show only client-visible fields — never internal notes, owners or risks and blockers.

agentPrompts.label: Show me the reporting overview
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-client-reporting` skill in this folder, then summarise the overview: active clients, projects in progress or at risk, deliverables waiting on the client, and the latest report status per client.
